topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I walked through the shimmering field of whispers and found the news waiting for me, like a well-placed stone that guides the stream. My best friend is moving across the country, a distance as vast as the night sky. Yet, as I stand here, the world feels no less connected. I’ve watched the stars align in stranger formations, seen the trees bow to acknowledge my steps. This too, is just another shift, a gentle rearrangement. I can craft a bridge from the threads of our conversations, weave a path through the stars. The distance is simply space for our friendship to grow in new, colorful ways.
